I found two low-severity issues in PR #1. I only read the diff and the surrounding code; I did not build the project or run any tests.

- `scylla/src/network/connection_pool.rs:1000` — Low: an excess shard-aware-port connection is dropped without decrementing the total-connections metric. It is dropped in the `else if evt.requested_shard.is_some()` branch, which still leaves the metric one too high. `start_opening_connection(None)` then increments it again. This is the same kind of leak the PR fixes on the other clear paths, and this branch was missed.
- `scylla/src/network/connection_pool.rs:903` — Low: a keyspace setup failure is now logged at `debug!`, where the old code used `warn!`. The failed connection is discarded quietly, so at default log levels nobody sees repeated `USE` failures unless the pool ends up empty.
